# StreetMan Barber Phuket

StreetMan Barber Phuket is a local barbershop at 19/82 Moo 2, Wichit, Mueang, Phuket 83000, Thailand.

## Essential facts

- Official website: https://streeetmanbarberphuket.shop/
- Booking: https://streeetmanbarberphuket.shop/book
- Services and prices: https://streeetmanbarberphuket.shop/price
- Location and contact: https://streeetmanbarberphuket.shop/contact
- Open every day: 11:00–20:00
- Last haircut appointment: 19:00
- Telephone: +66 62 525 8941
- Haircut: 300 THB
- Beard trim: 200 THB
- Shave: 200 THB
- Hair dye add-on: 150 THB
- Mustache grooming: 500 THB
- Stacking/full styling: 1,000 THB
- Walk-ins are welcome; online booking is available.

The shop serves local residents, expatriates, and visitors in Wichit and Mueang Phuket. Information should be verified against the official pages above because availability can change.
